dependencies.dependency: MCP23017 I2C GPIO expander driver. Add via: idf.py add-dependency espressif/mcp23017
I2C bus abstraction - pulled automatically by mcp23017 component.
Framework with I2C driver, GPIO, FreeRTOS task notifications.

constraints.constraint: HEADER-ONLY CONFIGURATION: All hardware values (GPIO pins, I2C addresses, timing) MUST use config_*.h constants. No magic numbers in source.
DUAL-CORE SEPARATION: MCP23017 operations run on Core 0 from safety_monitor_task (priority 24). Core 1 reserved for motion control.
INTERRUPT-DRIVEN SAFETY: Limit switch detection uses interrupts, not polling. Polling at 5ms is fallback only.
I2C MUTEX: All I2C transactions must be mutex-protected for thread safety.
TASK NOTIFICATION PATTERN: ISRs use xTaskNotifyFromISR() to wake tasks. Do not call blocking functions from ISR.
AC5: Read operations must complete within 500us at 400kHz I2C.
AC3: Interrupt latency must be less than 1ms from switch change to ISR execution.

tests.standards: Unit tests use ESP-IDF Unity framework. Integration tests require actual MCP23017 hardware. Test files follow pattern: test/test_*.c for unit, test/integration/*/ for integration. Hardware tests use oscilloscope for timing verification.
